title: Assyrian nobles campaign against Ellipi
summary: The Eponym Chronicle’s entry for 713 BC: the nobles (the eastern army) against Ellipi.
description: The Eponym Chronicle’s entry for 713 BC: the nobles (the eastern army) against Ellipi. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (Table 3, row 713, pp. 44–45; Table 2, row 713 (Eponym), p. 40).
